responsibility: Implements the gm2 link-command generator and checker tool that reads module/object lists and command-line options, then either emits or executes the final linker, archiver, or ranlib invocation. It parses driver flags such as `-B`, `-fobject-path`, `-ftarget-ar`, `-ftarget-ranlib`, `-o`, `--main`, `--startup`, `--exec`, and shared/archive modes; locates module and object files, avoids duplicate objects with `ObjectFiles`, builds the command line with library and startup handling, and supports both validation and actual command execution for the gm2 toolchain.
